geeklist.title: Black Friday / Early X-Mas Auction - Ends Sunday November 30th!!
geeklist.description:
Rules: Please read before bidding
d10-1 All bids must be in $1 increments. Items have a starting bid (SB) price and a Buy It Now (BIN) price. I will not accept bids below the SB price.
d10-2 Auction is U.S. only and currency is in USD. I am willing to discuss shipping outside the US, but please Geekmail me first. Winning bidders will have a Geekmarket item generated for them; all sales will go through the Marketplace so BGG will receive its 3% commission. All payments will be made through PayPal. Shipping to Canada is a maybe. Geekmail me the items you're considering and I will get you back a rough estimate.
d10-3 Payment is expected within 24 hours after confirmation of the sale. I reserve the right to cancel the sale if payment is not made in a timely fashion. I am reasonable, but please let me know if there will be a delay in payment for any reason.
d10-4 All games are complete and in great condition unless otherwise noted. All games comes from a smoke-free home with cats and dogs.
d10-5 Local pickup is available within 30 min of Fort Wayne, IN. Shipping is from 46825. I will combine shipping if you win multiple items.
SHIPPING
Shipping is generally $10 to the Midwest, $20 to the Coasts for a single item. I charge actual shipping.
I will choose the cheapest shipping option from among USPS Priority and USPS Flat Rate for any items that you win. For larger items, I will use UPS, as that is generally cheaper. If you have questions about shipping, feel free to Geekmail me and I will get you an estimate.
d10-6 I reserve the right to refuse any bids during the auction.
d10-7 No conditional bids permitted. Please don't withdraw a bid without contacting me first.
d10-8 Auction will end on Sunday November 30th sometime. Exact time is not being announced to discourage last-minute sniping.
d10-9 Once you have received your items from the auction, please leave feedback for me in the Market: Go to Market-->Feedback-->Pending Feedback.
Please comment or geekmail me with any questions. Thank you!
